Alvy Logistics is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Alvy Logistics is a full-service logistics company that provides comprehensive logistics solutions including warehousing, fulfillment, freight shipping, and same-day courier delivery services across Los Angeles and nationwide. Alvy Logistics employs 35 people (+59.1% YoY, +13 people), founded in 2021. Headquartered in Valencia, California, United States.

# Accurate Freight Systems

Accurate Freight Systems is a Truck Transportation company. Accurate Freight Systems is a company that provides comprehensive logistics solutions including freight shipping, warehousing, fulfillment, and courier & final mile. They have joined forces with Alvy Delivers to form Alvy Logistics. Accurate Freight Systems employs 13 people (-18.8% YoY, -3 people), founded in 2006. Headquartered in Valencia, California, United States, with an office in Valley View Ave.

## About

Accurate Freight Systems (AFS)® is a full-service transportation company that deals locally, regionally and nationwide. We offer a variety of services (same day pickup and delivery, carrier services, airfreight, LTL, TL, regional distribution, warehousing and fulfillment) that are designed to fit the needs of our customers.
